messages.source:
你从半掩的储物间里听见一阵玻璃瓶碰撞声。

一个披着旅行斗篷的年轻女商人坐在木箱上，脚边整整齐齐摆着几排魔力药水。她看见你身上的拘束具，先是愣了一下，随后把目光落在腰侧的贴身魔瓶上。

“嘘，小声点。我可是偷偷溜进来做生意的。”

她拿起一瓶药水晃了晃，瓶中的青色液体泛起细碎微光。

“外面带进来的真货，一点水都没掺。也可以暂时赊账，先赊着嘛。”
messages.text: A young merchant in a travel cap sits on a wooden box, with several rows of Mana 's potion on her feet. She sees the Restraint on your body, strangling first and then placing her eyes on the side of your waist. “Shh, quieter. I snuck in to do business.” She takes a bottle of medicine and shakes, and the white liquid in the bottle comes up thinly.

messages.source:

女药师笑着把旁边的遗物推到你面前。

“药效会留很久。至于这个，就当作试饮礼物啦。”
messages.text: You drink pink pills on your back. The sweetest potion is just swallowing, and the hotness of the hotness of the abdomen goes all over you; the nipples are fast and the rods are strangling, and the croaks are swollen. The pharmacist laughs and pushes the next thing in front of you. "The medicine will be long. As for this, it will be a tasteful gift."
You act first.

messages.source:
你刚在牌桌前坐稳，椅子里突然传出一连串机括声。皮带从扶手、椅背和椅腿间弹出，迅速扣住你的手腕、上身、腰部和脚踝，转眼便将你牢牢绑在椅子上，动弹不得。

魅魔看着你的反应，笑着压住最后一张牌。若肉棒上还佩戴着能够取下的性玩具，她便俯下身一件件解开，依次摆在桌边。

“最后一局，当然不能让你乱躲。”
“坐好，把赌注交出来。”
messages.text:
The moment you settle at the card table, mechanisms rattle inside the chair. Straps spring from the armrests, back, and legs, fastening around your wrists, torso, waist, and ankles until you cannot move.

The succubus watches your reaction with a smile and pins down the final card. If removable toys are fitted to your cock, she bends down, takes them off one by one, and places them beside the table.

“For the last round, I can't have you squirming away.”
“Sit still and hand over your stake.”

messages.source:
你刚踏进皮带群，数条皮带便同时扑了上来。手腕与脚踝先被并拢绑紧，另一条皮带贴着大腿内侧钻入胯下，绕住肉棒根部，将已经发硬的肉棒向上勒起。

最宽的那条皮带紧贴小腹扣合。粉色魔力沿着带身一股股灌入肉棒，龟头随之涨得鲜红，马眼持续向外渗出黏稠的前液。皮带每收紧一次，灌入体内的魔力便更深一分。

“齁唔……嗯啊……这、这魔力补给也太奇怪了吧……”

等到灌入的魔力停下，小腹上的皮带扣突然亮起。滚烫的纹路从扣环下方扩散开来，最终烙成一枚粉红色淫纹。

完成灌注后，漂浮皮带才依次解开，重新缩回走廊深处。小腹上的淫纹却仍在微微发热。
messages.text: You just stepped into the belt, and several belts came up at the same time. The wrists and ankles were first tied together, and another belt was inserted under the jaws on the inside of the thigh, rounding the root of the meat bar and strangling the already hard wand upwards.   The widest belt is attached to the small abdomen. The pink Mana pours into a meat bar along a piece of the body, and the turtle's head is red, and the horse's eye continues to see a thick frontal fluid out there. Every time the belt tightens, the Mana is inserted deeper into the body.   "Well, well, this, it's not even Mana of Common.  Wait till the Mana drops and the belt buttons on the small abdomen suddenly light up. The hot texture spreads under the collar and is eventually branded as a pink Lewd Mark.   When the infusion is completed, the drift belt is removed in turn and retrenched to the depth of the corridor. The Lewd Mark in the small abdomen still has a microheating fever.

messages.source: 你刚踢开最前面的一条皮带，周围的金属扣便同时弹开。三条漂浮皮带从带群中窜出，分别卷向你的双臂、腰间与双腿。
messages.text: You just kicked one of the belts in the front, and the metal buttons around you were popping away at the same time. Three floating belts came out of the bands, and they rolled into your arms, between your waist and your legs.

messages.source:
你刚躺进柔软的床褥，淡蓝色微光便贴着身体流入小腹。疲惫很快被暖意冲散，干涸的魔力也一点点补满。

睡意最浓时，床下悄悄伸出三件拘束具，挑中身体上的空处逐件缠了上来。等你醒来，魔力已经完全恢复，身上却多了三件新添的束缚。
messages.text: You've just been lying in a soft bed, and the light blue light is pouring into your belly. Wearyness is quickly dispersed, and the dry Mana is filled with a little bit. At the height of your sleep, three sets of Restraint are spread quietly under your bed, entangled in each of the empty parts of your body. When you wake up, Mana is fully recovered, with three new ties.

她腰侧压着一只半开的皮包，里面透出遗物的微光。

One floor on the other. There is no possibility of self-suspension.She's got a half-open purse on her waist. There's a little light inside of the relic. “Want to join us? We'll split whatever Mana we find.”

Their leader waves the map in her hand.

“Or you can go in alone. Just don't let anything in there wrap around you.”

messages.text:
When a single upper-arm, forearm, or wrist restraint reaches Tightness 3, it gains a random behind-the-back binding. Upper-arm bindings prevent the hands from reaching the thighs; forearm and wrist bindings also prevent access between the legs.
Linked: has separate Durability. Stacking does not affect Struggle damage, but affects Slip damage.
Integrated: has no separate Durability. Stacking affects both Struggle and Slip damage.
Lowering Tightness does not remove the binding. A linked binding is removed when its Durability reaches 0 or the original restraint is removed; an integrated binding is removed only with the original restraint. Reinforcing to Tightness 3 refreshes it, including from tier 2 back to tier 3.
Only works on the outermost layer. More may be added on the same layer, but ordinary restraints cannot be added outside it. A composite restraint placed over it removes the binding first.

messages.text:
Applying or reinforcing a single upper-arm restraint to Tightness 3 adds a pair of shoulder straps; they may also be applied separately. Each restraint supports one pair. Left and right straps have separate Durability; any number may occupy the shoulders on the same layer.

Reinforcing an ordinary single restraint back to Tightness 3 restores a missing strap without restoring the other strap's Durability. Single gloves cannot restore straps.

messages.source:
每个部位每回合可反复预备，只能成功释放1次。点击使用，右键切换施法预备／释放；也可拖到敌人身上。

腿部施法预备至少4层可用魔女飞踹：1能量、1伤害、打断，消耗全部腿部施法预备。各动作按对应部位判定成功率；失败保留施法预备，精神集中失去1层。
精神集中每层使下一次伤害魔法各段＋1，整次用完。对应身体部位将被拘束时，2层施法预备可抵挡1次；高潮清空四部位施法预备并失去1层精神集中。精神集中跨战斗最多保留2层，乌龟壳提高至4层。释放后动作自动切回施法预备。初始魔力与快感上限75，魔瓶50魔力；魔女护符在战斗每回合开始时获得1层魔力预备。
messages.text:
Each body part can prepare any number of times per turn, but can successfully release only once. Click to use; right-click to switch between Spell Preparation and Release. You can also drag the action onto an enemy.
Preparing any of the four parts costs 1 Energy and 5 Mana. Fire Arrow costs 1 Energy and 5 Mana for 6 damage; Flurry costs 2 Energy and 10 Mana for 4 damage to all enemies; Mind Intrusion costs 1 Energy and 5 Mana for 4 damage. Each Spell Preparation stack adds one hit, and a successful release consumes all preparation on that part.
With at least 4 Leg Spell Preparation, Witch Kick costs 1 Energy, deals 1 damage, and interrupts; it consumes all Leg Spell Preparation. Each action checks casting success for its corresponding body part. Failure preserves Spell Preparation and removes 1 Mental Focus.
Each Mental Focus adds 1 damage to every hit of the next damaging spell, then all stacks are consumed. When a restraint would be applied to the matching body part, 2 Spell Preparation can block it once. A climax clears Spell Preparation from all four parts and removes 1 Mental Focus. Retain up to 2 Mental Focus between battles, or 4 with Turtle Shell. After a release, the action automatically switches back to Spell Preparation. Maximum Mana and Arousal begin at 75; the Mana Flask begins with 50 Mana. Witch Amulet grants 1 Mana Reserve at the start of each combat turn.

messages.text:

Opening: starts with a {p1}-HP Puppet, granting it Taunt and retaliation when damaged on the first turn.
Actions: prepare a medium-grade tier-2 composite restraint -> prepare medium-grade tier-3 special equipment -> Mend; repeat. Mend raises the Puppet's maximum HP by 5 and fully heals it, then raises its ordinary-counter capacity by 1 and refills it.
Protective Barrier: takes at most {p2} final damage per turn. The limit scales with the cycle HP multiplier; direct damage and damage transferred from the Puppet share the allowance, which resets next turn.

messages.text:
HP: {p0}
Starts with a 10-HP puppet. Turn 1: Grant the puppet Taunt and a reaction that applies a restraint when damaged.
Then repeat: Raise puppet max HP by 5 and fully heal it; prepare a medium tier-2 composite restraint; prepare medium tier-3 special equipment. Each equipment category holds one prepared item; a new preparation replaces the old one.
The puppet cannot fall below 1 HP and transfers excess damage to its puppeteer. Multi-hit attacks trigger the reaction per hit. Area attacks ignore Taunt. Defeating the puppeteer dismisses the puppet; rewards are granted once.

messages.source:
生命：%s；小魔女遭遇时为%s。
特性：机械减伤。捕缚被挣开后，强化降低1层（最低0），机械减伤失效2回合并发呆1回合；铁男被击败时随行无人机与拘束盒同时停机。
开场：施加30/100捕缚，限制为坐姿或躺姿；替换普通平板锁并佩戴中级2档龟头榨精杯。诅咒平板锁或小魔女改为3件中级2档其他特殊装备。
捕缚：每累计消耗5能量，全部主动刺激型特殊装备触发1次。与凑数型无人机分别计数。
循环：捕缚＋10或重新捕缚→施加普通皮革拘束具并加固→施加复合皮革拘束具及强化附加项→按当前强化层数佩戴／替换杯具或替代特殊装备并补满电量→强化。
强化：每次使以后施加捕缚的数值＋5，并按紧度与普通数量／等级与普通数量／高级特殊装备与2把锁／普通与特殊数量及1把锁四组循环累计；第1、2、4组同时使加固量＋2档。无法施加的普通／复合拘束具改为加固。
杯具升级：1层全包，2层紧度3，3层马眼全包，4层高级；5层起杯具无额外升级。
无法佩戴杯具时：改为1层紧度3，2层数量＋1，3层升为高级，4层起每层数量＋1；开场和补电均按此规格施加／替换。
messages.text:
HP: {p0}; {p1} in the Little Witch encounter.
Trait: Mechanical Armor. When Capture is broken, loses 1 upgrade level (minimum 0), Mechanical Armor is disabled for 2 turns, and it idles for 1 turn. Defeating Iron Man shuts down the support Drone and Binding Box.
Opening: applies 30/100 Capture and restricts you to sitting or lying; replaces an ordinary plate lock and equips a medium-grade tier-2 glans milking cup. With a Cursed Plate Lock or in the Little Witch encounter, instead equips 3 other medium-grade tier-2 special items.
Capture: every 5 Energy spent triggers all active-stimulation special equipment once. Tracked separately from the Support Drone.
Cycle: Capture +10 or reapply Capture -> apply and tighten ordinary leather restraints -> apply a composite leather restraint plus upgrade extras -> equip or replace cup equipment, or substitute special equipment, at the current upgrade specification and fully recharge it -> Upgrade.
Upgrade: each level adds 5 to future Capture applications and cycles through four groups: Tightness plus ordinary count / grade plus ordinary count / advanced special equipment plus 2 locks / ordinary and special counts plus 1 lock. Groups 1, 2, and 4 also add 2 tiers of tightening. If an ordinary or composite restraint cannot be applied, tighten instead.
Cup upgrades: level 1 full-cover; level 2 Tightness tier 3; level 3 urethral full-cover; level 4 advanced. No further cup upgrade from level 5.
If cup equipment cannot be worn: level 1 instead sets Tightness tier 3; level 2 adds 1 item; level 3 upgrades to advanced; level 4 onward adds 1 item per level. Opening and recharge actions apply or replace equipment at this specification.

增生：每个玩家回合开始，施加1件初级2档或中级1档同类拘束具，敌人离场后停止。

Actions: 1. {p0} Growth; 2. Prepare; 3. Apply 2 {p1} restraints (basic tier 3 / medium tier 2 / advanced tier 1); 4. Reinforce up to 2 restraints to tier 3; 5. Charge; 6. Apply restraints across the body (medium tier 3 / advanced tier 2), including link ropes, then split at 50% maximum HP.
Growth: at each player-turn start, apply 1 restraint of the same material (basic tier 2 / medium tier 1). Stops when this enemy leaves.
Split: splits early if it survives a hit with HP at or below 50%; a killing hit prevents splitting. Creates 1 {p2} and 2 {p3}. The large enemy inherits current HP; each small enemy receives half, rounded up. They act from the next turn.

行动：①初级2档拘束具×2；②无力化1回合；③中级2档拘束具×1，准备就绪＋1；④优先施加中级马具口球或眼罩，无位置时改为其他普通拘束具。
后续：重复①③④两轮，第11次行动收押。
无力化：禁用体术，火球与卡牌魔法不受影响。
准备就绪：每成功施加或替换1件消耗1层，使该件直接达到3档；失败保留。③先用旧层数，再获得新层数。
范围：普通拘束具与链接绳，不施加复合拘束具；初级不含口球。出手时选择装备和位置，满位时可替换。
messages.text:
Actions: 1) Apply 2 basic tier-2 restraints. 2) Incapacitate for 1 turn. 3) Apply 1 medium tier-2 restraint and gain 1 Readiness. 4) Prefer a medium harness gag or blindfold; if neither fits, use another ordinary restraint.
Then repeat actions 1, 3, and 4 twice; arrest on action 11.
Incapacitated: disables physical skills. Fireball and card spells are unaffected.
Readiness: each successful application or replacement spends 1 stack and sets that restraint directly to Tightness 3; failed attempts preserve stacks. Action 3 spends existing stacks before gaining a new one.
Scope: ordinary restraints and link ropes; never composite restraints. Basic-grade applications exclude gags. Equipment and position are chosen when acting; legal replacement is allowed when full.

messages.source:
走廊前方传来一阵密集的金属轻响。

十几条漂浮皮带挤在一起，宽大的带身盘成一圈圈，几乎封死了整条路。皮带扣不断开合，像是在等什么东西主动靠近。

messages.text:
A rapid metallic clatter echoes from the corridor ahead.

More than a dozen floating belts crowd together, their broad straps coiling into rings that nearly block the passage. Their buckles snap open and shut as if waiting for something to come closer.

Pink mana shimmers along the inner faces of several belts, carrying a cloyingly sweet scent even at a distance.
